title: Counter Class
description: Create a class `Counter` that starts at 0. Methods: `increment()`, `decrement()` and `reset()`. Read the value through the attribute `value`. Two counters must not affect each other.

visible_tests.driver:
c = Counter()
c.increment()
c.increment()
c.decrement()
print(c.value)

hidden_tests.driver:
a = Counter()
b = Counter()
a.increment()
print(a.value, b.value)
